description: Header file defining a template-based message exchange mechanism with Type-Length-Value serialization, including nested classes for Request, Response, and Buffer, as well as a core MessageExchangeType class for managing communication states and data flow.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: Template struct implementing Type-Length-Value serialization with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a serializable request with type, length, and value, supporting serialization and reset.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Derived from Request, supports copying data from a Request.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Handles deserialization of stream data into Request objects, supporting iteration with Next() and Deserialize().

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: Core class managing message exchange, including link management, state handling, data sending/receiving, and synchronization.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested class inheriting from SOURCE, acts as a communication handler with virtual methods for state change, data send, and receive.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from a Request into a Response buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next data block in Buffer if available.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes stream data into internal buffer and request fields.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Triggers re-evaluation of message state and synchronization.

methods.name: ClaimSlot
methods.description: Claims a slot for a request, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: CompletedSlot
methods.description: Marks a request as completed, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares data for sending, triggers send if needed.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data stream, deserializes, and triggers receive callback.
